name: SBI (State Bank of India)
faq1: SBI home loan interest rates start from 8.50% p.a. linked to EBLR (External Benchmark Lending Rate) based on your CIBIL score.
faq2: SBI allows partial prepayment and foreclosure with zero penalty for floating interest rate retail loans.
faqCc: SBI Credit Card transactions over ₹2,500 can be converted into 3 to 24 month EMIs with interest rates starting at 14.0% p.a.

name: HDFC Bank
faq1: HDFC home loan interest rates start from 8.70% p.a. Calculate your exact monthly EMI for home, car, and personal loans.
faq2: HDFC offers up to 30 years repayment tenure for home loans, significantly lowering your monthly EMI liability.
faqCc: HDFC Credit Card SmartEMI allows converting big purchases into EMIs over 6 to 36 months with a small processing fee.

name: ICICI Bank
faq1: ICICI Bank loan EMI depends on principal amount, interest rate (8.75%+), and tenure (up to 30 years for home loans).
faq2: Prepaying ICICI Bank loans directly reduces outstanding principal, lowering total interest paid over the tenure.
faqCc: ICICI Bank Credit Card Instant EMI features flexible tenures from 3 to 24 months with interest rates starting from 13.5% p.a.

name: Axis Bank
faq1: Axis Bank provides competitive EMI plans for home, car, and personal loans starting at 8.75% p.a. interest.
faq2: Axis Bank loan tenure ranges up to 30 years for home financing and up to 7 years for auto loans.
faqCc: Axis Bank Credit Card EMI conversion allows converting purchases above ₹2,500 into 3 to 24-month EMIs via mobile app.

name: PNB (Punjab National Bank)
faq1: PNB home loan interest rates are among the lowest in India, starting at 8.45% p.a. for high CIBIL applicants.
faq2: PNB imposes zero prepayment penalties on floating rate retail housing loans.
faqCc: PNB Credit Card EMI options allow easy conversion of festival and travel expenses into low-interest monthly installments.

name: Kotak Mahindra Bank
faq1: Kotak Mahindra Bank offers quick online loan approval with home loan rates starting at 8.70% p.a.
faq2: Kotak personal loan EMIs can be calculated using the principal, monthly rate, and tenure formula.
faqCc: Kotak Credit Card EMI allows converting transactions over ₹2,500 into EMIs with zero documentation and instant digital approval.

name: Bank of Baroda (BoB)
faq1: Bank of Baroda offers Baroda Home Loan with competitive rates starting from 8.40% linked to Baroda Repo Linked Lending Rate (BRLLR).
faq2: BoB provides up to 30 years repayment tenure with zero prepayment charges for individual borrowers.
faqCc: Bank of Baroda credit cards offer Easy EMI conversion for purchases above ₹2,500 at low interest rates.

name: Canara Bank
faq1: Canara Bank Canara Housing Loan offers attractive interest rates starting at 8.40% p.a. for salaried professionals.
faq2: Canara Bank car loans are available for up to 84 months with minimal margin requirements.
faqCc: Canara Bank Credit Card EMI allows converting POS and online e-commerce transactions into affordable monthly payouts.

name: Union Bank of India
faq1: Union Bank of India Union Home Loan starts at 8.35% p.a. with concession for women borrowers.
faq2: Union Bank allows repayment terms up to 30 years with no penalty on early foreclosure.
faqCc: Union Bank credit cardholders can convert big-ticket expenditures into EMI through Union Miles/Union Bank app.

name: IDFC FIRST Bank
faq1: IDFC FIRST Bank offers custom home loan and personal loan solutions with paperless instant digital approval.
faq2: IDFC FIRST Bank personal loans feature flexible tenures from 12 to 60 months with interest starting from 10.49% p.a.
faqCc: IDFC FIRST Bank credit cards are famous for dynamic low interest rates starting from 9% p.a. with easy EMI options.

name: IndusInd Bank
faq1: IndusInd Bank provides home financing and auto loans with customized interest rate slabs based on credit score.
faq2: IndusInd Bank personal loans can be disbursed in as fast as 24 hours with minimal documentation.
faqCc: IndusInd Bank Credit Card EMI allows tenure selection from 3 to 36 months directly via WhatsApp banking or net banking.

name: YES Bank
faq1: YES Bank offers retail loans with competitive processing fees and flexible repayment options up to 30 years.
faq2: YES Bank personal loan rates range between 10.99% and 16.99% p.a. depending on borrower income and employer category.
faqCc: YES Bank Credit Card EMI offers instant conversion with zero foreclosure charges on select card tiers.

name: Bank of India (BOI)
faq1: Bank of India Star Home Loan features some of the lowest interest rates in the public banking sector starting at 8.30% p.a.
faq2: BOI offers special concessions for women applicants and green energy home construction.
faqCc: BOI credit cards allow easy EMI facility on retail and travel spending across verified merchant terminals.

name: Central Bank of India
faq1: Central Bank of India Cent Home Loan provides affordable home financing with tenures up to 30 years.
faq2: Central Bank car loans offer up to 85% on-road financing with minimal processing fees.
faqCc: Central Bank of India credit cards offer flexible installment payment plans for electronic and festival purchases.

name: Indian Bank
faq1: Indian Bank IB Home Advantage loan provides attractive floating rates linked to the RBI repo rate.
faq2: Indian Bank provides vehicle loans for new and pre-owned cars with tenures up to 7 years.
faqCc: Indian Bank credit cardholders can convert retail transactions above ₹2,000 into affordable 3 to 12-month EMIs.

name: Federal Bank
faq1: Federal Bank offers convenient digital home and car loans with competitive rates starting from 8.80% p.a.
faq2: Federal Bank personal loan requires minimal documentation with instant pre-approved limits for existing account holders.
faqCc: Federal Bank credit cards offer seamless EMI conversion via the FedMobile app.

name: Bajaj Finserv
faq1: Bajaj Finserv is India's leading NBFC for instant personal loans, No Cost EMI financing, and housing loans up to ₹5 Crore.
faq2: Bajaj Finserv personal loans offer flexi-hybrid repayment where you only pay interest on the utilized loan amount.
faqCc: Bajaj Finserv Insta EMI Card allows purchasing electronics, appliances, and mobiles on No Cost EMI across 1.5 lakh+ partner stores.

name: Tata Capital
faq1: Tata Capital offers quick digital personal loans, home loans, and business loans backed by the trust of the Tata Group.
faq2: Tata Capital home loans feature flexible EMI options including step-up and step-down repayment structures.
faqCc: Tata Capital credit and consumer finance loans offer instant approval with zero hidden charges.

name: Muthoot Finance
faq1: Muthoot Finance is India's largest gold loan provider with interest rates starting from 9.90% p.a. and instant gold evaluation.
faq2: Muthoot gold loans offer high per-gram valuation and flexible interest payout options (monthly, quarterly, or at maturity).
faqCc: Muthoot personal and vehicle loans provide instant funds against minimal income proof.

name: LIC Housing Finance (LIC HFL)
faq1: LIC Housing Finance (LIC HFL) Griha Suvidha offers affordable home loan interest rates starting from 8.50% p.a.
faq2: LIC HFL allows repayment tenures up to 30 years with special interest concessions for pension holders and women.
faqCc: LIC Credit Cards powered by Axis/IDBI offer easy EMI conversion on medical and education expenses.
